description: Reproducible production-build scenarios used before incremental-engine, cache, HMR, adapter, and operability changes are admitted.
why: A repeated build is not automatically cold or warm, and editing a real project during measurement risks corrupting user work. The baseline clones project inputs into an ignored temporary workspace for every sample, gives that workspace a private cache, and verifies that cold and warm builds emit the same semantic artifacts before publishing timings.

scenarios.proof: The sample starts with a newly created private cache directory.
The second build reuses the first build's cache and must emit the same semantic artifact fingerprint.
The first static page route is rendered through the production server configuration after the warm build.
A syntax-safe marker is appended to a stylesheet inside the disposable workspace.
A syntax-safe marker is appended to a client-boundary source, or the selected page source when no explicit boundary exists.
A syntax-safe marker is appended to a server/action/API source, or the selected page source when no narrower server file exists.
A syntax-safe marker is appended only inside the disposable workspace before the third build.
